side_comparator_policy.comparison_scope: Joint direction, reversal, occupancy, turnover and execution-cost policy comparison.
side_comparator_policy.interpretation: Random opposite proposals create additional reversals and much higher filled trade counts; the result does not isolate direction prediction at matched turnover or costs.
